messages:
Jordan (Sales): Heads-up — CorpWave POC starting next week. They require no public egress from our private deployment by default, but will allow specific outbound to vendor IPs. Also asking about PrivateLink vs VPC peering tradeoffs and whether we can support SNI-based proxying for multi-tenant egress.

Maria (SE): Thanks. Key asks: 1) allowlist for egress IPs/ports, 2) option for PrivateLink (preferred) + fallback peering, 3) TLS termination rules (they want end-to-end TLS except to our proxy), 4) pricing for NAT/eip egress on Dedicated.

Linus (NetEng): @Jordan quick Q — are they using a transit VPC or direct VPC in their account? That affects routing and whether PrivateLink endpoints are feasible.

Jordan (Sales): They said 'direct VPC' for now, might add transit later. CorpWave security team prefers PrivateLink endpoints to avoid exposing peering routes.

Linus (NetEng): Ok. PrivateLink profile: we can expose an interface endpoint in their VPC; traffic stays on AWS backbone. Pros: no route table peering, simpler allowlist. Cons: requires an ENI per AZ and cross-account endpoint policy. Also we need to surface the service name to them.

Ashley (SRE): Implementation notes: for PrivateLink we publish an NLB in our VPC fronting the inference endpoints. TLS can be passthrough to the model instance if corp insists; otherwise we terminate at the NLB and re-encrypt to backend. If they need SNI routing (multi-tenant hostnames) we can use ALB in front of NLB or ALB with TLS passthrough via TCP + proxy — complexity increases.

Maria (SE): Sample security ask we should give them (short):
```
- Outbound ports: 443 to our PrivateLink NLB IPs / service name
- If using peering: allow TCP 443 to 10.11.22.0/24 (example)
- Source NAT: we provide static egress IPs if they require allowlist
```

Linus (NetEng): If they insist on "no public egress", we can also offer a dedicated egress NAT via Transit GW or a managed egress proxy in their VPC that forwards to our PrivateLink. That proxy can do SNI-based routing and add SSO headers if needed.

Jordan (Sales): Pricing question from them: incremental cost for PrivateLink vs peering + egress NAT? They want a rough number to present to procurement.

Maria (SE): Rough ballpark for AWS costs (customer side): PrivateLink interface endpoint per AZ ~$0.01-0.02/hr + data processing $0.01/GB. Peering has no endpoint cost but egress via NAT/EIP and cross-AZ traffic could be higher. On our side: PrivateLink work + managed NLB support is covered under Dedicated/Private plan — but we should flag heavy egress tiers separately.

Ashley (SRE): For our quoting: list two SKUs — standard private connection (PrivateLink setup + support) and premium egress (static egress IPs, dedicated NAT pool, 24/7 support). Show cost per TB for egress beyond free threshold. I'll sync with finance for precise numbers.

Linus (NetEng): Small config snippet for their infra team (interface endpoint policy + SG):
```
# Security group on their side (allow outbound to our endpoint)
SecurityGroup:
  Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
  Properties:
    GroupDescription: allow-outbound-to-redwood
    SecurityGroupEgress:
      - IpProtocol: tcp
        FromPort: 443
        ToPort: 443
        CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 # or tighten to our endpoint private IPs
```
Note: they prefer tightening to specific ENI IPs once endpoint is provisioned.

Jordan (Sales): Also they sent a security questionnaire line about TLS certs — want to know who manages cert lifecycle for PrivateLink NLB. Answer?

Ashley (SRE): We can manage certs for the NLB (managed certs + rotation) as part of our Private offering. If they require their own keys, we support customer-provided certs via ACM import or BYOK with KMS/HSM for Private deployments.

Maria (SE): Next steps: 1) @Linus please draft a short diagram (PrivateLink + fallback peering) and sample allowlist for their infra team, 2) @Ashley pull a pricing row for dedicated egress + per-TB bandwidth, 3) Jordan to schedule a 30-min technical call with CorpWave sec + infra.

Linus (NetEng): Will do. Diagram + sample CloudFormation snippet by EOD.

Ashley (SRE): I'll open a quote ticket and post numbers here when ready.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RED-4567 for "CorpWave Private connectivity quote" assigned to Ashley.

Jordan (Sales): Great — thanks everyone. I'll cc CorpWave and set the call. :thumbsup:
